name: rank_therapeutic_targets
description: Use this tool to rank potential therapeutic targets for a specific disease based on genetic evidence, tissue expression, druggability, and literature support. Do not use this tool if you do not have a specific disease in mind or if you are looking for general information about therapeutic targets without specific criteria.

parameters.name: disease_name
parameters.description: The name of the disease for which therapeutic targets are being ranked. Must be a valid disease name recognized in medical literature.

parameters.name: genetic_evidence
parameters.description: A list of genetic evidence items supporting the potential targets. Each item should be a string representing a specific genetic finding related to the disease.

parameters.name: tissue_expression
parameters.description: A list of tissues where the potential targets are expressed. Each item should be a string representing a tissue name.

parameters.name: druggability_score
parameters.description: A score representing the druggability of the targets, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, where 1.0 indicates highly druggable targets. Default is 0.5 if not provided.

parameters.name: literature_support
parameters.description: A list of references or studies supporting the potential targets. Each item should be a string representing a citation or link to the literature.

ranked_targets.description: An array of objects representing the ranked therapeutic targets.

target_name.description: The name of the therapeutic target.

rank.description: The rank of the target, with 1 being the highest priority.

score.description: A composite score based on genetic evidence, tissue expression, druggability, and literature support.

return_schema.description: A ranked list of therapeutic targets based on the provided criteria.
